{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = data[data['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
valid_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(mean_age)"}
